data.title: Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike — Low-and-Slow Buildup Followed by Bust-Out
data.description: Detects the characteristic synthetic identity bust-out pattern: prolonged low credit utilization (< 35% for 6+ months) followed by a rapid spike to near-maximum utilization (> 80%) within 30 days. Synthetic identity fraudsters nurture credit profiles over 12-24 months with steady payments and low utilization, then execute a coordinated bust-out where all available credit is maxed simultaneously. The Federal Reserve estimates synthetic identity fraud costs U.S. lenders $6B+ annually. The discontinuous utilization jump from a stable baseline is the hallmark behavioral indicator.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_utilization_history AND filter_current_spike AND filter_previous_month

enrichment_required.source: Rolling 6-month average utilization from credit bureau or internal reporting

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike
// Detects bust-out pattern: 6+ months low utilization then rapid spike
(account_type="consumer_credit" OR account_type="credit_card")
trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct<35
current_utilization_pct>=80
previous_month_utilization_pct<50
| utilization_jump_pct := current_utilization_pct - previous_month_utilization_pct
| months_at_low_utilization := payment_history_months
| groupBy(account_id, function=[
    collect([credit_limit, current_balance, current_utilization_pct,
             trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct, utilization_jump_pct,
             account_open_date])
  ])
| sort(utilization_jump_pct, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike")`
`comment("Detects 6+ months low utilization followed by rapid spike to >80%")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:credit_monitoring
  (account_type="consumer_credit" OR account_type="credit_card")
  trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct<35
  current_utilization_pct>=80
  previous_month_utilization_pct<50
| eval utilization_jump = current_utilization_pct - previous_month_utilization_pct
| eval risk_score = case(
    utilization_jump > 70 AND trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct < 20, "critical",
    utilization_jump > 50, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table account_id, account_type, credit_limit, current_balance,
        current_utilization_pct, trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct,
        previous_month_utilization_pct, utilization_jump,
        account_open_date, risk_score
| sort - utilization_jump
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike
-- Detects bust-out pattern: prolonged low utilization then rapid spike
SELECT
  a.account_id,
  a.account_type,
  a.credit_limit,
  a.current_balance,
  a.current_utilization_pct,
  h.trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct,
  h.previous_month_utilization_pct,
  (a.current_utilization_pct - h.previous_month_utilization_pct) AS utilization_jump,
  a.account_open_date,
  DATEDIFF(MONTH, a.account_open_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS account_age_months
FROM credit_accounts a
JOIN credit_utilization_history h ON a.account_id = h.account_id
WHERE a.account_type IN ('consumer_credit', 'credit_card')
  AND h.trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct < 35
  AND a.current_utilization_pct >= 80
  AND h.previous_month_utilization_pct < 50
ORDER BY utilization_jump DESC

references: Federal Reserve, Synthetic Identity Fraud in the U.S. Payment System (2024)
OCC, Comptroller's Handbook: Credit Card Lending — Synthetic Identity Red Flags
falsepositives: Legitimate large purchases (wedding, home renovation) causing temporary utilization spike
Consumers consolidating debt via balance transfer to a single card
